purpose: Offline change to the BC Sapling policy using matched observations of official terminal margin under counterfactual complete physical root orders. An action was forced only at the root. Later both arms use historical V1 for our seat and the full original Master3s2 for the rival. One sample per arm. Regression is off-policy relative to the present BC. No new games, no formal or current development seeds and no deployment.
seed_selection: Fit maps are the intersection of train in joint_response_critic_dev/native_inputs and train membership in cargo_tree_action_learning_dev/native_actor_corpus/sources. Held is exactly native_inputs' four old held terrains (28 signed roots); these older research data have previously been examined and are held only from our new fit. Some of the fit maps were internal validation maps for other past studies. Those studies do not provide independent evaluation of our result.
samples: Use every primary of these shared one-root-intervention protocols on the eligible maps, regardless of signed return, seat or magnitude. Repeated secondary response streams remain outside the gradient and held point estimates as their original contract requires. Keep both scores, source hashes, complete suffix hashes, opponent root and response stream IDs. Exclude partially unrepresentable full orders as a pair and report them in the denominator.
objective: For each arm compute its complete team's autoregressive log probability given the archived public observation using an action-specific regenerated prefix, actor plus frozen partner, and guard branch selected at the root. Sum action log probabilities over discretionary slots; forced probability-one terms are zero. Predict g=[new log p(B)-log p(A)]-[old log p(B)-log p(A)]. Target [margin(B)-margin(A)]/1000, all signed magnitudes, no label clipping. Map-equal squared error plus 0.25 times the two-arm mean of summed prefix KL(old||new). The log probabilities are differentiable scoring surrogates for the deterministic greedy release. Only Sapling policy tensors train; frozen value heads and frozen partner. Export a fixed last checkpoint as a real INT8 single file.

screen.criteria: All held maps yield supported pairs. Mean map-equal signed prediction MSE improves vs g=0; strict majority of maps improve; positive map-equal change in independent signed two-arm choice using the higher absolute joint log probability (ties A). Record actual unforced orders for parent and child even if neither equals either priced choice. At least four changed actual orders with both sides priced across at least two maps, aggregate priced delta positive, and no changed roots with an unknown third order. Inadequate coverage cannot infer actual gain. Report all maps, ties, misses and negative results. No retuning on these maps. Passing justifies separate prospective evidence; historical held roots are not new strength games.
